verdict.rationale: The evidence pack focuses on GitHub Mobile's UI features (Copilot agent tasks, code review, search) but contains no documentation of an API that mirrors these mobile-specific UI capabilities; the probe for an OpenAPI/swagger spec on GitHub's docs site returned 404s for all candidate paths, giving no evidence of programmatic parity with the app's UI actions (assigning Copilot, triaging, code review, agent task management). Missing for 10: any documented REST/GraphQL endpoints covering Copilot agent tasks or mobile-specific workflows, and any independent confirmation that these actions can be performed purely via API.
